Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook installing and configuring a PostgreSQL 15 server: package install, pg_hba.conf with allowed CIDRs, postgresql.conf tuning for production, service start, and a database+user creation step.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure PostgreSQL 15 for production
  hosts: postgres_servers
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    pg_version: "15"
    pg_port: 5432
    pg_listen_addresses: "*"
    pg_data_dir: "/var/lib/pgsql/{{ pg_version }}/data"
    pg_conf_dir: "/var/lib/pgsql/{{ pg_version }}/data"
    pg_bin_dir: "/usr/pgsql-{{ pg_version }}/bin"
    pg_service_name: "postgresql-{{ pg_version }}"

    pg_allowed_cidrs:
      - { cidr: "10.0.0.0/8", method: "scram-sha-256" }
      - { cidr: "192.168.0.0/16", method: "scram-sha-256" }

    pg_databases:
      - name: appdb
        owner: appuser
        encoding: UTF8
        lc_collate: en_US.UTF-8
        lc_ctype: en_US.UTF-8

    pg_users:
      - name: appuser
        password: "{{ vault_appuser_password | default('ChangeMe_UseVault!') }}"
        priv: "ALL"
        db: appdb
        role_attr_flags: "LOGIN,NOSUPERUSER,NOCREATEDB,NOCREATEROLE"

    # Production tuning - adjust per host resources
    pg_max_connections: 200
    pg_shared_buffers: "2GB"
    pg_effective_cache_size: "6GB"
    pg_work_mem: "16MB"
    pg_maintenance_work_mem: "512MB"
    pg_wal_buffers: "16MB"
    pg_checkpoint_completion_target: 0.9
    pg_random_page_cost: 1.1
    pg_effective_io_concurrency: 200
    pg_min_wal_size: "1GB"
    pg_max_wal_size: "4GB"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Validate OS family
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - ansible_os_family in ['RedHat', 'Debian']
        fail_msg: "This playbook supports RedHat/Debian families only."

  tasks:
    # --- RedHat-family installation ---
    - name: Install PGDG repository (RHEL family)
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: "https://download.postgresql.org/pub/repos/yum/reporpms/EL-{{ ansible_distribution_major_version }}-x86_64/pgdg-redhat-repo-latest.noarch.rpm"
        state: present
        disable_gpg_check: true
      when: ansible_os_family == 'RedHat'

    - name: Disable built-in PostgreSQL module (RHEL 8/9)
      ansible.builtin.command: dnf -qy module disable postgresql
      args:
        creates: /etc/dnf/modules.d/postgresql.module
      when:
        - ansible_os_family == 'RedHat'
        - ansible_distribution_major_version | int >= 8

    - name: Install PostgreSQL packages (RHEL family)
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name:
          - "postgresql{{ pg_version }}-server"
          - "postgresql{{ pg_version }}-contrib"
          - "postgresql{{ pg_version }}"
          - python3-psycopg2
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == 'RedHat'

    # --- Debian-family installation ---
    - name: Install prerequisites (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - curl
          - ca-certificates
          - gnupg
          - lsb-release
          - python3-psycopg2
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_os_family == 'Debian'

    - name: Add PostgreSQL GPG key (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc
        dest: /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/postgresql.asc
        mode: '0644'
      when: ansible_os_family == 'Debian'

    - name: Add PGDG apt repository (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
        repo: "deb http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt {{ ansible_distribution_release }}-pgdg main"
        state: present
        filename: pgdg
      when: ansible_os_family == 'Debian'

    - name: Install PostgreSQL packages (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - "postgresql-{{ pg_version }}"
          - "postgresql-contrib-{{ pg_version }}"
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_os_family == 'Debian'

    - name: Set Debian-specific paths
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        pg_data_dir: "/var/lib/postgresql/{{ pg_version }}/main"
        pg_conf_dir: "/etc/postgresql/{{ pg_version }}/main"
        pg_bin_dir: "/usr/lib/postgresql/{{ pg_version }}/bin"
        pg_service_name: "postgresql@{{ pg_version }}-main"
      when: ansible_os_family == 'Debian'

    # --- Initialization (RHEL only; Debian auto-inits) ---
    - name: Check if PostgreSQL data is initialized (RHEL)
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ pg_data_dir }}/PG_VERSION"
      register: pg_data_check
      when: ansible_os_family == 'RedHat'

    - name: Initialize PostgreSQL database (RHEL)
      ansible.builtin.command: "{{ pg_bin_dir }}/postgresql-{{ pg_version }}-setup initdb"
      when:
        - ans
